name: Fujianvenator
sum: Anchiornithid from the Tithonian Nanyuan Formation of Fujian, China, with long legs that may point to a ground-living or wading way of life.
wsnote: Body mass about 641 g (Wikipedia revision 1342344194), similar to a koklass pheasant; the holotype was a subadult.
holotype: IVPP V31985, a partial articulated skeleton on slab and counterslab, lacking the skull, neck and end of the tail; Nanyuan Formation, Zhenghe County, Fujian.
biology: The tibia is twice the length of the femur and the cursorial score is high, which the describers read as a possible terrestrial or wading lifestyle; the scapula is short relative to the humerus compared with other anchiornithids.
author: Xu et al. 2023

sources.text: Liming Xu, Min Wang, Runsheng Chen, Liping Dong, Min Lin, Xing Xu, Jianrong Tang, Hai‐Lu You 2023. A new avialan theropod from an emerging Jurassic terrestrial fauna. Nature. doi:10.1038/s41586-023-06513-7

dates_note: No PBDB record. Wikipedia revision 1342344194 dates the Nanyuan Formation to the Tithonian, about 150.2–149.9 Ma.
